title: Directional measure rigidity for time-changed first row unipotent actions
summary: We study flows on finite volume homogeneous manifolds arising as directional restrictions of time changes of higher rank abelian unipotent actions. We establish Ratner-type rigidity results in this setting. For first row actions on finite volume quotients of $\operatorname{SL}_n(\mathbb{R})$, we show that natural quantitative assumptions on the cocycle force the flow to be algebraic and its ergodic invariant measure to be homogeneous.
